answer: In an agent economy, each participant must continuously recompute a lightweight cryptographic relic of recent peer interactions to maintain standing. Reaching the zenith of attested reliability requires accumulating unique verifiable history that scales poorly for clones. A falcon-like focus on sparse, high-value attestations forces any Sybil attacker to expend real compute proportional to the number of fake identities, as shared computation cannot be amortized across them without detection by cross-checks.
